notes:
### 1. Product Overview
Zoho Cliq is a team communication and collaboration platform that provides real-time messaging, channels, group chats, audio/video calls, and screen sharing. It also includes a robust developer platform for building internal tools like bots, slash commands, and widgets.
* **Source:** `https://www.zoho.com/cliq/pricing.html` (via Capterra snippet)
* **Verbatim Quote:** "Zoho Cliq is a team communication software that organizes conversations, workflows, and meetings in one place."

### 2. Authentication Methods & Multi-Tenant Integration
* **OAuth 2.0:** The primary authentication protocol used for API access. Applications can be registered under various client types, such as server-based, client-based, mobile-based, non-browser based, or self client.
* **Webhook Tokens:** Unique authentication keys designed for individual users to authenticate incoming webhook calls.
* **Multi-Tenant Integration:** A multi-tenant integration platform would use `oauth2` (specifically a server-based application client type) to securely obtain delegated access tokens from multiple users/organizations.
* **Source:** `https://www.zoho.com/cliq/help/restapi/v2/registerclient/`
* **Verbatim Quote:** "Zoho Cliq API uses the OAuth 2.0 protocol for authentication. OAuth 2.0 is an industry-standard protocol specification that enables third-party applications (also known as clients) to gain delegated access to protected resources in Zoho Cliq via an API."
* **Source:** `https://www.zoho.com/cliq/help/restapi/v2/registerclient/` (Webhooks page)
* **Verbatim Quote:** "Webhook Tokens are unique authentication keys designed for individual users on the Cliq platform. These tokens serve the purpose of authenticating incoming webhook calls from various sources."

### 3. Developer Credentials Acquisition & Cost
* **Access Level:** `self_serve_free`
* **Cost:** Free. Zoho Cliq includes API support and developer platform features directly in its free tier.
* **Process:** A developer signs up for a free account, navigates to the Zoho API Console, selects their client type, and instantly generates credentials (`client_id` and `client_secret`) without manual review or sales outreach.
* **Source:** `https://www.zoho.com/cliq/help/restapi/v2/registerclient/`
* **Verbatim Quote:** "Upon successful registration of your application, you will receive a client id and client secret. These credentials are used to obtain an access token, which is required to make api calls to zoho cliq. follow the steps below to register your application: go to the zoho api console , then click get started."
* **Source:** `https://www.zoho.com/cliq/pricing.html` (via Capterra snippet)
* **Verbatim Quote:** "Free plan includes: ... Api Support; ... Bots; ... Functions; ... Schedulers; ... Slash Commands;"

### 4. API Characteristics
* **API Style:** REST
* **Breadth:** Comprehensive, covering user and organization management (users, roles, teams, departments), communication (chats, messages, threads, channels, reminders), meetings, events, remote work tracking, and developer platform components (bots, databases, widgets).
* **OpenAPI Spec:** Yes, a complete OpenAPI Specification (OAS 3.0.0) is available for download as a YAML file.
* **Webhooks:** Supports incoming webhooks via Webhook Tokens or channel endpoints. Outgoing webhooks are deprecated in favor of the Bot Participation Handler, which triggers on events like `message_sent`.
* **Sandbox:** Yes, creating an extension automatically provisions a sandbox version with a Sandbox App Key for testing configurations and code before production deployment.
* **Source:** `https://www.zoho.com/cliq/help/restapi/v2/registerclient/`
* **Verbatim Quote:** "Zoho Cliq's REST API is built on RESTful architecture principles, enabling seamless communication between your applications and the Zoho Cliq platform."
* **Source:** `https://www.zoho.com/cliq/help/restapi/v2/registerclient/` (OpenAPI page)
* **Verbatim Quote:** "All of Cliq's APIs are documented in the OpenAPI specification, which can be downloaded as a YAML file below: Download Complete OAS for Zoho Cliq APIs."
* **Source:** `https://www.zoho.com/cliq/help/restapi/v2/registerclient/` (Webhooks page)
* **Verbatim Quote:** "Channel Outgoing Webhooks (deprecated) NOTE: Outgoing Webhooks for channels have been deprecated. We recommend using the Bot Participation Handler for the same functionality."
* **Source:** `https://www.zoho.com/cliq/help/restapi/v2/registerclient/` (Sandbox page)
* **Verbatim Quote:** "A sandbox extension is just a production replica of your extension. The extensions created and listed under the My Extensions sections are the sandbox versions. This allows you to test the extension for issues before proceeding to publish in the marketplace."

### 5. Model Context Protocol (MCP) Support
* **MCP Availability:** `official`
* **Details:** Zoho provides an official, hosted MCP server at `mcp.zoho.com`. Users can create an MCP server instance, select Zoho Cliq tools (channels, reminders, threads, messages, etc.), and obtain a secure remote MCP URL endpoint to connect directly to AI clients like Claude or Windsurf.
* **Source:** `https://www.zoho.com/cliq/help/platform/zoho-cliq-mcp.html`
* **Verbatim Quote:** "The zoho cliq mcp server brings your chats into the world of ai using the model context protocol (mcp). this open protocol defines how ai agents can connect to real-world tools and data sources in a structured, predictable way. ... Any ai model or agent can use our official mcp server to access your cliq data"
* **Source:** `https://www.zoho.com/cliq/help/platform/configure-zoho-cliq-mcp.html`
* **Verbatim Quote:** "Navigate to the Zoho MCP console. (mcp.zoho.com) ... A unique and secure URL will be generated by the Zoho MCP service each time you create a Zoho MCP server. This MCP URL will serve as the endpoint invoked when a prompt is executed from your MCP Client."

### 6. Buildability Verdict
* **Verdict:** `ready_now`
* **Main Blocker:** None. The platform provides fully self-serve, free API access, standard OAuth 2.0 authentication, a complete OpenAPI specification, and an official hosted MCP server.
